- **Fixed "No tab with a video" in the browser extension** for tabs that were
  already open when the extension was installed or updated. The extension now
  reaches those tabs by itself, so there's no need to reload YouTube (or any
  other page) after installing or updating.
- If you're on 0.2.3 or 0.2.4, the extension offers this update itself:
  download, unzip over the same folder, press Reload.
